unique.reason: Unique removes the second a and preserves first occurrence order.

count.reason: Count returns one integer equal to the source population length three, including duplicates.

concat.reason: Concat combines the literal prefix with each unique value in document order.

merge.reason: Lexical ascending merge joins the unique values with the explicit comma delimiter.

split.reason: Literal comma splitting preserves the adjacent empty middle part.

regex_capture.reason: The first capture group is independently extracted from each ordered URL value.

substring.reason: One-based start 1 and length 3 produce the first three characters of each input.

time_difference.reason: The UTC date difference between 2026-01-02 and 2026-01-01 is 86,400 seconds.

arithmetic.reason: Adding scalar 2 to the ordered [3, 4] population preserves the two Cartesian results.

to_integer.reason: Signed decimal strings, including leading zeros, convert elementwise without changing order.

begin.reason: The source begin transformation prepends / only when absent, so etc becomes /etc while /var remains unchanged.

end.reason: The source end transformation appends / only when absent, so etc becomes etc/ while var/ remains unchanged.

input.reason: The required exactly-one integer binding is supplied as [7] and is not replaced by a literal or default.

values.reason: The values projection reads full_path from two collected file Items in document order; no field or status is synthesized.
